title: Change footer credit text to V1.0

requirements.summary: Replace the footer credit text "Built by Hannes" with "V1.0" everywhere the same footer is rendered (normal layout and access-denied layout).
acceptanceCriteria: When viewing any page that shows the app footer (including the access-denied screen), the footer displays exactly: "V1.0".
The previous footer text "Built by Hannes" is no longer visible anywhere in the UI.

file_operations.description: Update the footer text node within the existing footer markup (including the access-denied render branch and the normal app layout footer) to display exactly "V1.0" instead of "Built by Hannes", without changing any other copy or layout.
